fields.Name: T58 - Entity Form Edit Member
fields.Description: Verifies that an existing Member record can be edited and the change saved through the entity form, confirming the update-and-save path works for the Members entity.

InputDefinition.goal: IMPORTANT: To open the 'Members' entity, use the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box — type 'Members' and click the node named EXACTLY 'Members' (individual member people, ~2000 records; NOT 'Board Members', 'Campaign Members', 'Member Follows', 'Memberships', 'Membership Types', 'Chapter Memberships', or 'Committee Memberships'). Do NOT fight a group expand-chevron. Navigate to Data Explorer, open the 'Members' entity, click a member row, and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full member form. Change an editable field such as Title or City to a new value, then click Save. Reach the state where the change is saved (a save confirmation appears or the new value is persisted in the form). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for loads and saves to finish rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The full member form is open and an editable field such as Title or City was changed to a new value
A save was performed and a save confirmation or the persisted new value is visible
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
